name: Thorner
source:
You are Colin Snead, a military veteran. Haunted by your time in the service, you flee to the Scottish wilderness attempting to escape your past. However, you will find that spilled blood is not easily forgiven, and you are not alone. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

You can wishlist Thorner on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/4394090/Thorner/
translation:
你是退伍軍人科林．斯尼德。軍旅歲月的陰影揮之不去，你逃進蘇格蘭荒野，試圖擺脫過去。然而你會發現，流過的血沒有那麼容易得到寬恕，而這裡也不只你一個。這片土地知道你做過什麼。這片土地將審判你。索納正在等著你。

你可以在Steam上將《Thorner》加入願望單：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4394090/Thorner/
